title: Finite presentation detected by an etale scheme presentation
statement: Let $T$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum] and let $Y$ be an algebraic space over $T$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For a morphism of algebraic spaces, finite presentation means quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness (quasi-compact diagonal), and local finite presentation on etale scheme charts [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. The following are equivalent: (1) $Y\to T$ is of finite presentation; (2) there is a scheme $W$ over $T$ and a representable surjective etale map $q:W\to Y$ such that both $W\to T$ and $R=W\times_YW\to T$ are of finite presentation. Here $R$ is a scheme by representability of the diagonal, and scheme finite presentation has the same meaning [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. When (1) holds, $W$ in (2) can be chosen affine. Etale maps and fibre products are those of [def-weil-etale-morphism] and [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers, def-pc-fibre-product].

proof.text: Assume (1). The affine scheme $T$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs]. Apply [lem-sfb-space-fp-qcqs-source] to $Y\to T$: $Y$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Thus [lem-sfb-qc-space-affine-etale-atlas] supplies an affine scheme $W$ and a representable surjective etale map $q:W\to Y$. The morphism $W\to T$ is locally of finite presentation by [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test], applied with target chart $T\to T$ the identity and source chart $W\to Y$. Both $W,T$ are affine, so [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs] and [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1) give quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of $W\to T$. Hence $W\to T$ is of finite presentation.

source.place: Tag 03H6, lemma-quasi-compact-affine-cover; spaces-morphisms.tex Tags 06G5 and 0410, lemma-finite-presentation-local, with the identity target chart.

proof.text: Form $R=W\times_YW$. Representability of the diagonal in [def-trf-algebraic-space] makes $R$ a scheme; [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers] makes $p_1:R\to W$ etale. Since $W,Y$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated, [lem-sfb-qcqs-space-fibre-product] makes $R$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The definition [def-weil-etale-morphism] gives local finite presentation of the scheme map $p_1$. By [lem-sbc-locally-finite-presentation-composition], $R\xrightarrow{p_1}W\to T$ is locally of finite presentation. The finiteness conditions for $R\to T$ follow from [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1), since $T$ is quasi-separated. Thus $R\to T$ is of finite presentation. This proves (2) and the affine choice asserted after it.

source.place: Tag 073B, lemma-quasi-compact-quasi-separated-permanence; scheme composition of local finite presentation, morphisms.tex Tag 01TR.

proof.text: Conversely assume (2). Because $T$ is affine, [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine] applied separately to the finitely presented scheme morphisms $W\to T$ and $R\to T$ shows that both schemes are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. In particular [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1) makes $p_1:R\to W$ quasi-compact: its source is quasi-compact and its target quasi-separated. Now [lem-sfb-space-qs-atlas-criterion] applies to $q:W\to Y$ and gives quasi-separatedness of $Y$. This argument uses the actual scheme $R=W\times_YW$ and its projection; it does not infer quasi-compactness of that projection merely from its being etale.

source.place: Tag 07S4, lemma-quasi-separated, after checking its quasi-compact projection hypothesis by scheme permanence.

proof.text: The point map $|q|:|W|\to|Y|$ is continuous by [lem-a1-space-affine-etale-cover] and surjective by representable surjectivity [def-trf-algebraic-space]: after pulling back to a field-valued point, the nonempty scheme fibre has a point with a residue field extension. Pull an open cover of $|Y|$ back to $|W|$; quasi-compactness of $W$ gives finitely many members covering $W$, and surjectivity says those same members cover $Y$. Thus $Y$ is quasi-compact.

Apply [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test] to $Y\to T$ with the given source chart $W\to Y$ and the identity target chart $T\to T$. Since $W\to T$ is locally of finite presentation, so is $Y\to T$. Finally [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-permanence] applied to $Y\to T$ gives quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of that morphism from the absolute quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness just established and the quasi-separatedness of the affine scheme $T$. These are exactly the three conditions in (1).

source.place: Tag 0410, lemma-finite-presentation-local, part (6), and Tag 073B, lemma-quasi-compact-quasi-separated-permanence, part (2).

lean.statement: theorem fp_iff_etale_scheme_presentation {S : Scheme.{u}} (T : Over S) [IsAffine T.left] (Y : AlgebraicSpace S) (f : Y.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj T) : (MapIsQuasiCompact f ∧ MapIsQuasiCompact (pullback.diagonal f) ∧ MapToSchemeIsLocally (@LocallyOfFinitePresentation) Y T f) ↔ ∃ (W : Over S) (q : yoneda.obj W ⟶ Y.obj.obj), IsEtale q ∧ IsSurjective q ∧ (LocallyOfFinitePresentation (yoneda.preimage (q ≫ f)).left ∧ QuasiCompact (yoneda.preimage (q ≫ f)).left ∧ QuasiSeparated (yoneda.preimage (q ≫ f)).left) ∧ ∃ (R : Over S) (p₁ p₂ : R ⟶ W), IsPullback (yoneda.map p₁) (yoneda.map p₂) q q ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (p₁.left ≫ (yoneda.preimage (q ≫ f)).left) ∧ QuasiCompact (p₁.left ≫ (yoneda.preimage (q ≫ f)).left) ∧ QuasiSeparated (p₁.left ≫ (yoneda.preimage (q ≫ f)).left)
lean.note: The first declaration is the presentation equivalence; the second states the affine choice under finite presentation. Reuses MapIsQuasiCompact and MapToSchemeIsLocally from the landed def-sfb-proper-curve-moduli, added to stmt_deps. The actual relation scheme is specified by its Yoneda pullback square; its map to T is induced by the first projection. No statement correction.
